description.value: Cora is a popular Canadian breakfast-and-lunch chain known for its generous fresh-fruit platters, creative crêpes, eggs, and waffles. The Abbotsford location offers dine-in, takeout, delivery, and outdoor patio seating, making it a solid fueling stop in the Fraser Valley. Early opening hours align well with cyclists' typical dawn departure times.
